new_fields.Description: Sunlord MWSA0402S-R47MT 0.47uH +/-20%; DCR 14mOhm max; manufacturer table Isat Max/Typ 7.6/9.5A and Irms Max/Typ 6.65/7.5A (manufacturer headings retained; not guaranteed minimum). Max height 2.0mm. Selected for compact power loop; supply and EVT pending.

applied_groups.qualification: 2025/5/29 manufacturer MWSA catalog pp2-3: R47 ordering code, 4.2+/-0.25 x 4.4+/-0.35 x 1.8+/-0.2mm, 1.5x2.5mm lands at +/-1.85mm. SGM62125 Rev.A.3 requires Isat >=1.2x worst peak. Engineering scenario Vin1.9V, Vout3.3V, Iout2A, eta80%, f2MHz and Lmin0.376uH gives 5.23A peak/6.28A target; f/eta are assumptions, not guaranteed corners. The lower catalog current column is labelled Max, not a guaranteed minimum; obtain the exact saturation/temperature-rise criteria before treating it as a worst-case bound. Exact current-limit/temperature/thermal validation and transient EVT pending. 0515 alternative discarded before commit because its larger body caused collisions and would enlarge switching loops.

new_fields.Description: Sunlord MWSA0402S-1R0MTB01 1uH +/-20%; DCR 27mOhm max; manufacturer table Isat Max/Typ 8/9A and Irms Max/Typ 5.4/6A (manufacturer headings retained; not guaranteed minimum). Max height 2.0mm. Exact B01 variant required; 1R0MT is not an equivalent. Supply and EVT pending.

applied_groups.qualification: 2025/5/29 manufacturer MWSA catalog pp2-3 explicitly lists 1R0MTB01 (not ordinary 1R0MT): 4.2+/-0.25 x 4.4+/-0.35 x 1.8+/-0.2mm, 1.5x2.5mm lands at +/-1.85mm. SGM41513 typical circuit specifies 1uH; this is an intentional filter change from 2.2uH. Conservative buck scenario VBUS13.5V, D0.5, f1.38MHz and Lmin0.8uH gives 3.057App ripple, 4.529A peak at 3A average, 3.13A RMS and 0.265W winding loss using DCRmax27mOhm (core loss excluded). Frequency minimum applies at stated datasheet temperature, not all corners. SYS plus charge and boost-mode/OCP/thermal budgets remain EVT. Do not substitute ordinary 1R0MT.
